headline: Software Engineer to our Retail Finance domain
description_text: Come and help us create the scalable banking experiences our customers need, combining the speed, experimentation, and customer focus of a modern product team. In this role, you will work closely with stakeholders, customers, and experienced engineers to shape and build innovative financial services in a rapidly changing market. Get an idea of the role We are looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about building exceptional customer experiences within retail banking and financial services. We operate as a true product team, not a collection of individuals working through separate backlogs. We solve problems together through continuous collaboration. Rather than relying on heavyweight processes and detailed upfront planning, we value fast feedback, experimentation, and iterative delivery. A key part of our engineering approach is using AI-powered development practices and agentic workflows. We are looking for engineers who embrace this with evolving pace and excited to help shape how we build modern software. You will work closely with colleagues across the bank and directly with customers: effective communication skills, and relationship-building just as important as technical expertise. Our technology decisions are intentional and pragmatic. We favor serverless architectures, managed cloud services, and modern engineering practices that allow us to move quickly while maintaining security, reliability, and scalability. We focus our energy on solving customer problems rather than managing infrastructure. If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy exploration and discovery, and want real influence over what gets built and how, we are that kind of team. On a personal level Requirements for the role: Strong proficiency in TypeScript Comfortable working across both frontend and backend Hands-on experience with AWS-based systems Experience deploying and operating services in production Solid technical judgement within own area of responsibility Able to reason about trade-offs across frontend, backend and cloud architecture with support from senior engineers Comfortable taking technical decisions with end-to-end responsibility. Meriting skills Serverless solution design in AWS Knowledge of IAM and security patterns in AWS Experience owning services or components in production Resurs in brief At Resurs, we make everyday finances easier through innovative and customer-focused solutions. With customers across the Nordics and more than 800 colleagues, we are committed to creating long-term value for individuals, businesses, and society. Recognized as a career company for the past six years, we put strong emphasis on both personal and professional growth. We want to make a difference by striving to be our best, acting with kindness, and building trust through clarity and collaboration. Our heart beats strong and it shows in everything we do. Although we are based in the Nordics, our team is enriched by the breadth of perspectives brought by colleagues from different countries. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users. Apply today! Don’t wait to send in your application. Selection and interviews take place on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date. We look forward to hearing from you! Important information On final candidates, we carry out a detailed background check via an external company. #LI-LN1

headline: Production & Project manager - Podme
description_text: Vill du driva marknadsföringskampanjer och projekt från start till mål för några av Sveriges största podcasttitlar, som Alex & Sigge, Ursäkta och JLC:s Mellan himmel och jord? Är du en skicklig produktionsledare med starka projektledaregenskaper och erfarenhet av att arbeta datadrivet med köpta digitala kanaler för att driva försäljning? Podme söker nu en Production & Project Manager till deras svenska marknadsavdelning. Ett föräldravikariat på 16 månader, från 1 oktober 2026 till februari 2028. Arbetsbeskrivning I rollen som Production & Project Manager hos Podme får du möjlighet att arbeta brett inom marknadsföring och projektledning. Produktionerna varierar i storlek och du arbetar parallellt med flera produktioner samtidigt. Marknadsteamet består av fyra personer och du rapporterar till svenska marknadschefen Hedvig Engnell. I rollen ingår: Leda, koordinera och kvalitetssäkra produktionsledet - brief, underlag, säkerställa korrektur, deadlines och levereras av slutgiltigt material. Projektleda och följa upp arbetet med Performance Marketing i samarbete med vår digitala byrå, inklusive analys av kampanjresultat och säkerställa optimering utifrån data, performance, rekommendationer och affärsmål. Säkerställa att allt material följer Podmes brand guidelines. Delta i arbetet med marknads- och kommunikationsplaner för podcast- och ljudbokstitlar Arbeta nära det svenska innehållsteamet och delta i projektgrupper för podcastlanseringar. Agera beställare mot externa byråer och andra samarbetspartners. Din profil Vi söker en person som har ett proaktivt förhållningssätt och erfarenhet av köp av media, direkt och via byrå. Du kommer, tillsammans med övriga kollegor på marknadsavdelningen, ansvara för att bygga varumärkeskännedom, skapa efterfrågan och driva konvertering med hjälp av mycket starkt podcast- och ljudboksinnehåll. Vi tror att du har: +4 års erfarenhet av projekt-/ produktionsledning på en marknadsavdelning eller byrå. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av mediaköp, inklusive performance marketing - direkt och i samarbete med digitala byråer samt av att arbeta med säljdrivande digitala kampanjer. Förmåga att omsätta data från plattformar som Meta och Google Ads till konkreta optimeringar av kampanjer och kreativt material. Du behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift. Du har en högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande inom marknadsföring. Meriterande är erfarenhet av B2C-brand, streaming eller abonnemangstjänster. Production & Project Manager är en utvecklande roll där ingen dag är den andra lik – du trivs sannolikt bäst om du gillar att arbeta i en tillväxtmiljö. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt, förmåga att arbeta självständigt och proaktivt samt ett öga för detaljer. Som person är du social, energisk och positiv. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor med interna kollegor och externa samarbetspartners, så du behöver vara en duktig kommunikatör, relationsbyggare och teamplayer. Om Podme Podme är en streamingtjänst för podcasts och ljudböcker och tillhandahåller lyssnarupplevelser kostnadsfritt och i abonnemangsform. Podme erbjuder dig: En nyckelroll i ett bolag på stark tillväxtresa, med en bred portfölj av spännande podcasts och ljudböcker. Även om vi är ett relativt ungt bolag (vi grundades 2017) är vi också en del av Schibsted-koncernen (med varumärken som Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet m.fl) och sitter i Schibsted-kontoret på Kungsbron, Stockholm. Upplägget är hybrid. Övrig information Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 16 månader, heltid med start den 1 oktober. Kontoret är i Schibsted-huset på Kungsbron i centrala Stockholm. Sök gärna tjänsten omgående . Vi intervjuar löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta: Mia Ljunggren WorkStudios +46 730 66 55 22 WorkStudio arbetar med kompetensbaserad metodik i sina rekryteringar och hanterar alla kvalificerade ansökningar utan hänsyn till kön, ålder och bakgrund.

headline: Senior Accountant – Swedbank Robur Fonder AB
description_text: Är du intresserad av en stimulerande och utvecklande roll inom redovisning? Vill du jobba hos oss på Corporate Accounting inom Sveriges största fondbolag? headline: Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
description_text: If you choose to apply, please read the job ad in full and include a short cover letter. We are most interested in hearing from the real you, so we encourage authentic applications written in your own words. The opportunity in a nutshell Interested in combining hands-on data engineering with close collaboration across the business? This role could be a good fit for someone with 4+ years of experience who enjoys building reliable data products and working with others to make them useful. Role : Join as a Data Engineer in our Data Product Engineering team within Schibsted's Data & AI organization, where we build reliable, well-governed, and scalable data products used across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other parts of the business. Core tools and practices : Our everyday toolkit includes SQL and Python as core languages, together with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Terraform, and Git, supported by solid engineering practices around testing, documentation, CI/CD, and version control. Company : Schibsted is home to some of the most established and widely used media brands in the Nordics, including Aftenposten, VG, Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet, E24, Bergens Tidende, and Stavanger Aftenblad. Across our broader Data & AI focus, data, analytics, and AI help us build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across those newsrooms and businesses. Location : This role is based in Oslo or Stockholm. We work in a hybrid setup, which means this is not a fully remote role, and candidates need to reside in Sweden or Norway and be able to work from one of our offices at least 2 days a week. Why this role : You will join a relatively new team with room to contribute, learn, and help shape how we work as we continue to build trusted data products across Schibsted. Sounds like your kind of role? Read on Who are you? We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering who is also excited by the opportunity to keep learning, deepen their craft, and grow together with the team. You have around 4+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role, with a track record of building reliable data solutions in production environments. Strong SQL skills are important, along with a solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and how to design data products that are useful, trustworthy, and maintainable. You can write and debug SQL and Python yourself at a strong professional level. AI-assisted tools are welcome, but this role requires solid enough fundamentals to solve everyday engineering problems without depending totally on them. On the Python side, we are looking for good software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to structure maintainable applications and apply object-oriented design principles where appropriate. You have hands-on experience with dbt in production environments and solid working knowledge of the wider toolkit we use, including Airflow, Snowflake, AWS, Terraform, Git, and Python and / or similar tools. You will likely enjoy this role if you are comfortable making pragmatic technical decisions in environments where requirements evolve and not everything is fully defined upfront. You care about engineering quality and can contribute to practices around testing, documentation, observability, governance, and cost-efficient pipeline design. Clear communication matters just as much as technical strength. We value people who can work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders , explain tradeoffs clearly, and contribute positively to team collaboration and knowledge sharing. What's the job like? As a Data Engineer , your job is to help us build data as a product, not just pipelines that move data from one place to another. You will create robust data models, improve the reliability and scalability of our pipelines, and help shape the engineering practices that make our data products trusted and reusable across Schibsted Media. What you will be expected to do Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into pragmatic, well-scoped data solutions. Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and transformations in Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python. Develop scalable data models that support analytics, reporting, and future AI use cases. Improve technical quality through testing, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable engineering practices. Contribute to good architectural and implementation decisions across the team. Contribute through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing within the team. Work closely with adjacent platform and Data & AI teams to align on standards, dependencies, and shared ways of working. What success looks like Success in this role means growing into a confident contributor who understands our data landscape, ways of working, and stakeholder needs. Over time, that includes contributing across a mix of smaller support tasks through our weekly rotation as well as larger pieces of work , helping build reliable pipelines and data models, and developing the judgment to deliver pragmatic solutions together with the team. Depending on your experience and the needs of the work, that can mean contributing as part of a team or taking the lead on a project . Why join us? You will join a team that is still shaping its ways of working , which means there is real room to contribute, learn, and grow. You will work on data products with visible impact across Schibsted , supporting both technical and non-technical users in domains such as Product, Subscription, Finance, and HR. You will be part of a company whose work matters in everyday life across the Nordics , helping support trusted media brands through better data, analytics, and AI capabilities. You will work in an international environment with strong trust, autonomy, and good opportunities for learning through engineering communities and collaboration across Data & AI. You will join a team that enjoys solving challenging problems, wants to build high-quality data products, and cares about the people they work with. Got your attention? Let us hear from you! The application period closes on 28 September 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

headline: Spontanansökan, Aftonbladet
description_text: Vill du jobba med oss på Sveriges största nyhetssajt? Vi söker medarbetare redan i höst! Varje dag ger vi läsare, tittare och lyssnare senaste nytt inom nyheter, nöje sport och feature. Vi granskar makten, utmanar de styrande och avslöjar missförhållanden. Dessutom både informerar vi och underhåller. Vi är alltid intresserade av att komma i kontakt med nya kollegor då vi kontinuerligt är i behov av inhoppare och vikarier. Välkommen att skicka in en spontanansökan! Några av våra avdelningar: Breaking news: Vad är det som har hänt? Flera miljoner svenskar vänder sig till Aftonbladet varje dag för att få svar på den frågan. Aftonbladet skapade en stark breakingdesk 2015 och vi har inte haft en lugn stund sedan dess. Nu är vi Sveriges största och roligaste nyhetsdesk och söker dig med dokumenterad erfarenhet av sådant som liverapportering, omvärldsbevakning och snabb nyhetsvärdering. Vi söker både reportrar och onlineredaktörer. Sportbladet: Sportbladet startades 8 maj 2000 och är idag Sveriges största sportdestination med ca 1,5 miljoner läsare varje dag – dygnet runt. Den rosa redaktionen har lyft svensk sportjournalistik till en helt ny nivå genom åren. Sportbladet finns digitalt, som daglig sportbilaga, poddar, tv-format och sportbiblar. Redaktionen bevakar all världens idrott med fokus på fotboll, hockey, vinteridrott och mästerskap och har blivit prisad för sin journalistik och innovation vid ett flertal tillfällen. Vi söker både skrivande reportrar, redaktörer och tv-medarbetare. Video: Aftonbladets livesändningar och nyhetsinslag når miljoner svenskar varje dag. Ett ansvar vi tar på största allvar och som tvingar oss att ständigt förnyas. Vi livebevakar de största händelserna, förklarar de svåraste skeenderna med grafiska inslag och fördjupar Aftonbladets berättande med videojournalistik. Vi arbetar i små team där alla har en viktig roll såväl i breakinglägen som planerad produktion. Sociala medier: Som sociala medier-specialist på Aftonbladet kommer du att jobba med att optimera, skapa och publicera innehåll i alla de olika kanaler där vi på Aftonbladet är aktiva – Instagram, Facebook, Youtube och Tiktok. Tillsammans med resten av redaktionen kommer du även att utforma och testa nya format på de olika sociala medier-plattformarna för att sprida Aftonbladets journalistik och engagera vår publik. Radio: Den 17 augusti startade Aftonbladet Sveriges första kommersiella och rikstäckande aktualitetsradiokanal, Aftonbladet Radio. Som nyhetsinsittare hittar, värderar och berättar du nyheter – snabbt, träffsäkert och med rätt ton. I rollen tar du fram nyheter till våra radiosändningar och läser upp dem. Det är en roll för dig som gillar puls, ansvar och att vara mitt i nyhetsflödet när det händer och erfarenhet av breakingjournalistik är meriterande. Som researcher ligger du steget före i nyhetsflödet, tar fram fakta, vinklar och relevanta perspektiv och säkerställer att programledarna har rätt underlag, i rätt tid. När tempot ökar behåller du lugnet och prioriterar klokt. Du planerar sändningen, bokar gäster, hittar röster som berör och ser till att lyssnarnas perspektiv får plats i programmet. Nöjet: Aftonbladet Nöje är Skandinaviens största förmedlare av nöjesnyheter. Dagligen engagerar och informerar vi miljoner läsare med de största nyheterna och snackisarna kring tv, musik, film och kändisliv. Våra läsare älskar mixen av tunga avslöjanden och lättare kortisar och vi brinner för den. Det hoppas vi att du som söker dig till Nöjesbladet också gör. Vad vi kan erbjuda? • En stimulerande arbetsplats där du når en miljonpublik. • Kunniga, smarta och drivna kollegor och en trevlig arbetsmiljö • Krävande och erfarna chefer som får dig att utvecklas varje dag. • Engagerad publik som hjälper oss att bli bättre. Välkommen med din ansökan!

headline: Credit Risk Analyst, Danish Portfolio
description_text: Our Credit & Analytics department is known for being one of the most forward-thinking in the Nordics, made up of talents from across the globe. Within it, the Credit Underwriting & Decision Analytics unit focuses on continuously improving our automated underwriting processes and monitoring risk performance, always with an eye on what's next. About the role: As our unsecured portfolios grow in size and complexity, you help shape the future of our Danish portfolio. Credit underwriting sits at the core of an unsecured lending bank, and internally we simply call this "running the bank." You coordinate closely with stakeholders across departments. What you'll be doing: Collaborate with business, product and cross-functional teams, bringing credit risk expertise into business decisions Work with data and data structures to build a strong foundation for monitoring and connect insights to business and risk outcomes Contribute to continuous improvement of credit risk strategies, tools and processes Develop and enhance data-driven monitoring and reporting for proactive risk management Understand how data flows through our systems to identify opportunities and improve decision-making Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike Who we're looking for: You are creative, curious and analytically sharp, someone who enjoys challenging and improving existing methods with data. You see how data flows through business processes and use that to spot opportunities and create value. You thrive collaborating across backgrounds, motivated by tangible business impact. Beyond that, we're looking for someone with: At least 5 years' experience in credit risk within the Danish market. Knowledge of credit bureau data, regulatory requirements and market-specific credit risk factors for Denmark. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and present findings clearly. Strong communication skills, able to explain complex findings in an understandable way. Experience with analytical tools such as R, Python, SAS or SQL/Databricks. A degree in a quantitative field such as Economics, Finance, Statistics or Data Science. Fluency in English; Scandinavian language skills are a plus. Nice to have: Familiarity with reporting tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP). Practical information: Start: as soon as possible Location: Stockholm Form of employment: Fixed position Working hours: Full time Hourly wage/fixed wage 💰 Have you heard of NOBAVERSE? In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly ! ✨ Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page. Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ . We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health. Read more about how we handle your personal data here . If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter. We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

headline: Application Security Engineer
description_text: We are looking to extend our cybersecurity team to support Schibsted Media and the journalists along their journey for free and independent press. Located in Norway and Sweden, the team is responsible for providing, supporting and maintaining cybersecurity tools for the company as well as providing safe products and services to our customers and journalists. We are part of the tech department, the cybersecurity team collaborates with the other part of the organisation: journalists, editors, it-infrastructure, network, user devices, collaboration software… What will you do in this role? As an application security engineer, where you will be instrumental in fortifying our applications and products against potential threats and vulnerabilities. You will work closely with software developers, architects, and system engineers to integrate security measures throughout the software development lifecycle. Your expertise will be crucial in conducting security assessments, implementing best practices, and ensuring the integrity and resilience of our digital assets. Your main responsibilities will be to: Support the different teams in remediating security issues or vulnerabilities in accordance with the best practices. Contribute to the development of security training and education programs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security into the software development lifecycle. Assist in the development and maintenance of security documentation, policies, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Stay updated on emerging threats and industry trends, making recommendations for continuous improvement of our security posture. Implement and manage security tools and technologies to enhance application security. Act as a key contributor to building a robust cybersecurity culture within the organisation. Key competencies: Background in software development, pentest of web applications, infrastructure and network. Good knowledge of common application security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10) and mitigation techniques. Experience with security assessment tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, and Metasploit. Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in web development such as Java, Python, along with familiarity with web technologies like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

headline: Product Engineer – AI & Digital Workplace
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The Position As a Product Engineer at Cambio, you'll design, build, and evolve digital products that improve efficiency, quality, and the employee experience across the company. Working at the intersection of engineering, AI, and business improvement, you'll help transform how we work by turning opportunities into solutions that deliver measurable value. You'll partner with business stakeholders, IT teams, and end users to identify problems, build practical solutions, and continuously improve them over time. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building, iterating quickly, and taking ownership from idea to operation. You'll have significant freedom to shape products, ways of working, and technical solutions while helping drive Cambio's adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace technologies. We Offer An opportunity to build and evolve strategic digital products that directly impact how Cambio operates and delivers value. You'll work in an environment that embraces: AI-first thinking and experimentation Product ownership and end-to-end responsibility Pragmatic engineering and rapid iteration Modern cloud and workplace technologies Continuous learning and innovation We believe in empowering engineers to own outcomes, make decisions, and continuously improve both products and ways of working. We move fast, focus on value, and are not afraid to challenge established ways of working when there is a better solution available. About You We believe you're a curious builder who gets energy from solving real problems and turning ideas into working solutions. You're not someone who waits for perfect requirements, complete roadmaps, or consensus. You take ownership, move things forward, and focus on outcomes rather than activity. You enjoy working close to the business, understanding pain points, and using technology to make work simpler, faster, and better. You'll thrive in this role if you: Have a strong "get things done" mentality. Take ownership from idea to production. Balance speed with quality and security. Challenge complexity and look for simpler ways of working. Enjoy collaborating across technical and business teams. Continuously look for opportunities to automate, improve, and create value. At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together. It's important to us that you recognize and identify with these values. Requirements Strong hands-on experience across frontend and backend development. Proven experience building, shipping, and operating products in production environments. Strong understanding of software engineering, cloud platforms, integrations, and APIs. Experience identifying business needs and translating them into practical solutions. Demonstrated ability to take products from concept through implementation and continuous improvement. Experience applying AI, automation, or data-driven approaches to improve efficiency and quality. Strong operational mindset with focus on reliability, supportability, and measurable outcomes. Self-driven, pragmatic, and comfortable working in areas where no playbook exists. Can communicate fluently in both spoken and written english Microsoft & AI Ecosystem Experience Experience with, or strong interest in, the Microsoft ecosystem including: Microsoft 365 Copilot SharePoint Online Teams and Loop Entra ID and Purview Power Platform and Microsoft Graph AI agents, automation, and governance You understand how these technologies can be combined to create secure, scalable, and user-friendly solutions that drive productivity and business value. It's a Bonus If You Have Experience building AI-powered assistants, agents, or autonomous workflows. Experience with Power Platform, Azure AI, or Microsoft Fabric. Experience with enterprise architecture, governance, or digital workplace platforms. Experience working in highly regulated environments. Experience with IT Service Management (ITIL) practices. Experience measuring and driving adoption of digital products. Good communication skills in both written and spoken swedish Additional Information Place of employment: Stockholm or Linköping Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period The role involves access to sensitive information; therefore, a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application! CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible - explore our employee benefits Learn more about our recruitment process here Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

headline: Butikssäljare till Malmö, Mobilia
description_text: Letar du efter en arbetsplats för framtiden? Att besöka en av Telenors butiker ska vara en upplevelse i världsklass! Våra kunder bemöts därför av personal med god kunskap om våra produkter och tjänster. Vi strävar alltid efter att hitta den bästa lösningen för varje kund och göra det komplicerade enkelt i alla lägen. Så letar du efter en arbetsplats där du får vara med och bidra till det viktigaste som finns – relationerna mellan människor? Då är du välkommen till oss på Telenor! Är du den vi söker? Vi behöver dig som är på tårna! Du har en genuin vilja att lära och utvecklas så att vi kan möta kunders ständigt föränderliga behov – idag och imorgon. Driv och engagemang är något vi värderar högt, och vi ser det som en grund för att skapa resultat och långsiktig framgång. Vi söker dig som har disciplin i ditt arbete – du tar ansvar och ser till att dina uppgifter blir gjorda på ett effektivt sätt. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och tar initiativ för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna – både för kunden, teamet och dig själv. För att söka denna tjänst behöver du ha fyllt 18 år och behärska svenska i både tal och skrift. Det är även meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av kundkontakt, exempelvis inom kundservice eller försäljning, antingen över telefon eller i butik. Har du dessutom grundläggande kunskaper i säljteknik ser vi det som ett stort plus. Så kommer du göra skillnad hos oss Som butikssäljare befinner du dig i hjärtat av vår verksamhet – i kundmötet. Att öppna dörrarna till butiken, innebär att komma rakt in i pulsen. Det är här vi hjälper våra kunder att få ett bättre abonnemang, den senaste hårdvaran eller att fixa fakturastrulet. Det handlar helt enkelt om att få bort vardagens störningsmoment så att våra kunder kan fokusera på det viktiga i livet. Ge kundservice i världsklass: Du möter kunderna där de är, och skapa en upplevelse som överträffar förväntningarna. Rådgivning: Genom att kombinera produktkunskap och lyhördhet guidar du kunden till rätt lösningar. Bidra till kampanjer och aktiviteter: Du håller dig uppdaterad om aktuella erbjudanden och bidrar till en trivsam och engagerande butiksmiljö för alla besökare. Hålla butiken i toppskick : I nära samarbete med teamet säkerställer du en trivsam, välorganiserad och inbjudande butiksmiljö. Våra löften till dig Vi är bättre tillsammans . Hos oss möts du av en familjär och inkluderande kultur, en stark gemensam värdegrund och ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet och handlingskraft. Vi tror på att ge varandra förtroende och frihet att agera och fatta beslut, samtidigt som vi är där för varandra i med- och motgångar. Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen . Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum. Vi ger plats för livet . Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu. Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående. Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa . Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. I butikerna fokuserar vi på att coacha, utveckla och ge dig rätt verktyg för att trivas och växa. Telenor erbjuder både fysiska och digitala utbildningar anpassade för just din utvecklingsresa. Genom Växa, vår utbildningsplattform, och andra lärandeinitiativ får du därmed möjligheten att utvecklas och forma din egen karriär. Majoriteten av våra tjänster tillsätts internt så när du vill vidare väntar möjligheterna här. Sök till oss idag Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mejl. Bra att känna till Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du få göra tre tester som fokuserar på din personlighet och färdigheter. Enligt Telenors policy genomför vi även bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samtliga rekryteringar.

headline: EDD Analyst
description_text: Get an idea of the role We are developing our Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function and are looking for an EDD Analyst to contribute across its full scope. The role offers broad exposure and involvement throughout the end-to-end FCP framework. You will conduct in-depth enhanced due diligence and risk assessments of highrisk customers and counterparties, including PEPs, complex ownership structures, and highrisk jurisdictions. Using OSINT, adverse media, and financial data, you will develop well-founded risk assessments and produce high-quality EDD reports. You will work closely with onboarding teams as well as Compliance, Fraud, Customer Care, Product, and other key stakeholders. In addition, you will actively contribute to the development and continuous improvement of EDD processes, typologies, and ways of working as the function evolves. On a personal level You thrive in a changing environment, in fact, you find it energizing. You're comfortable with ambiguity and see it as an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You communicate complex findings clearly, both in writing and in conversation, and you bring a collaborative mindset to everything you do. Requirements for the role: A degree in law, finance, criminology, or a related field 3+ years of experience from a financial institution conducting EDDs Strong interest in AML, compliance, and financial services Strong analytical skills and attention to details Excellent communication and documentation skills High integrity and the ability to handle sensitive information responsibly Fluency in Swedish and English Resurs in brief At Resurs, we make everyday finances easier through innovative and customer-focused solutions. With customers across the Nordics and more than 800 colleagues, we are committed to creating long-term value for individuals, businesses, and society. Recognized as a career company for the past six years, we put strong emphasis on both personal and professional growth. We want to make a difference by striving to be our best, acting with kindness, and building trust through clarity and collaboration. Our heart beats strong and it shows in everything we do. Although we are based in the Nordics, our team is enriched by the breadth of perspectives brought by colleagues from different countries. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users. Apply today! Don’t wait to send in your application. Selection and interviews take place on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date. In this process, you will receive a logic test sent to you as part of our selection method. We look forward to hearing from you! Important information On final candidates, we carry out a detailed background check via an external company. #LI-LN1

headline: Senior Accounting Specialist – Join Our Transformation
description_text: Are you passionate about accounting and eager to play an active role in shaping the future of our finance function? In Swedbank you have the opportunity to: • To contribute to our transformation toward operational excellence while developing your own skills in a dynamic environment. • Be part of a high-performing and supportive team that plays a key role in Swedbank AB’s financial closing process. • Gain broad exposure across the finance function, working with both parent company and branch accounting. • Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes. • Deepen your expertise by supporting the interpretation and implementation of accounting regulations. • Take an active role in projects and change initiatives, helping shape how we work going forward. • Drive continuous improvement by enhancing processes, routines, and ways of working to ensure efficiency and high-quality accounting. • Have the opportunity to grow professionally and expand your responsibilities within a transforming finance organization. What is needed in this role: • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, or an equivalent field. • 3–4+ years of experience in accounting or finance roles. • A solid understanding of Swedish and international accounting standards. • A collaborative team player who can also work independently when needed.. • Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English. • A proactive mindset with a strong drive for improvement and development. • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. • Good knowledge of Excel and other MS Office tools. With us, you can experience: Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development. Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society. An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities. A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role. Enjoy country-specific benefits , including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden. "Join our team and... ...be a part of our transformation journey to build a solid accounting organisation to meet future requirements on finance function. We foster a culture of excellence, making our department a home for professionals and top talent in our field. You will be given the opportunity to develop professionally as a specialist and take part in change initiatives and activities to meet our challenges with a continuously changing environment and infrastructure, and at the same time increasing Swedbank’s competitive advantage”. Agne Baronaite, your future manager We look forward to receiving your application by 12.10.2026. Location: Stockholm, Sundbyberg Recruiting manager: Agne Baronaite We may start the selection during the application period and welcome your application as soon as possible. We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role. We have made our choice regarding recruitment media and therefore kindly decline contact with ad sellers or sellers of other recruitment services. Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome. #LI-Hybrid

headline: System Engineer within Kubernetes
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position We are looking for a System Engineer to join our IT Operations and Infrastructure team, working primarily with our Kubernetes-based container platform. You will design, operate, and continuously improve the platform that runs our products, with responsibilities covering security, multi-tenancy, recoverability, and observability. Our platform is based on Red Hat OpenShift, but we place stronger emphasis on solid Kubernetes knowledge rather than prior OpenShift experience. If you are comfortable designing and operating Kubernetes platforms, you will quickly be able to learn the OpenShift-specific parts with our support. The role involves close collaboration with internal development and operations teams and includes responsibility for incident management and service delivery in a regulated and security-critical environment. We are a team of eight engineers operating the container platform as a managed service under strict security requirements and SLAs. As Cambio transitions from traditional product delivery to a managed SaaS model, the platform plays a critical role in how we scale, modernize, and operate our services. This means you will have real opportunities to influence both technical direction and ways of working. We place high value on team culture and believe it is fundamental to delivering sustainable results. If you care as much about how a team collaborates as what it delivers, you will fit in well with us. We offer: Join a passionate group of experts working with modern technologies and industry best practices, where collaboration leads to real impact A dynamic environment full of new challenges and a broad technology stack to keep your skills sharp and your work exciting Technical freedom to influence the tools and technologies you work with, empowering you to craft the best solutions About you We believe that you are passionate about solving technical challenges and have effective communication skills when cooperating across teams. You thrive in a changing environment and independently drive your own and your team's work forward. At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values. Requirements Experience working with Kubernetes platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift Experience working with GitOps and continuous delivery Experience with Helm or similar deployment tooling Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Experience in scripting, automation, and development work Experience of Linux, preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Worked according to DevOps/DevSecOps principles Can communicate fluently in both spoken and written english It's a bonus if you Experience with RBAC, network policies, or cluster hardening Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, or similar observability tooling Experience with log aggregation tools such as OpenSearch or Elasticsearch Experience with IT security including certificates, encryption, or firewalls Experience from Azure, AWS or other public or internal cloud Good communication skills in both written and spoken swedish Additional information: Place of employment : Linköping or Stockholm Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) or fully remote Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. Due to the summer holiday period, feedback regarding the recruitment process may take a little longer than usual. We expect to get back to you no later than week 34. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We look forward to receiving your application! CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible - explore our employee benefits Learn more about our recruitment process here Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

headline: Senior Data Engineer
description_text: Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others. As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place. Ready for your next chapter? We are now on the lookout for a platform-focused Senior Data Engineer to join the team in Stockholm. About the Team The Data Engineering team is responsible for empowering Storytel with data. We drive the full data lifecycle, from ingestion to delivery, and help ensure that the rest of the business have the data, tools and engineering collaboration needed to help make informed data-driven decisions. As a team, we provide cross-functional competencies in data engineering as well as analytics engineering to the rest of Storytel. Some of the tech stack and tools we work with are dbt (SQL), Looker, BigQuery, Python, Airflow, Terraform, CI/CD, Github, Airbyte as well as other products included within the Google Cloud Platform. Moreover, we like to keep our skills up to date by frequently engaging lab days. About the Role As a Data Engineer, your main responsibility will be to enable the team and the rest of the organization with a data platform and the tools that power data at Storytel. You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to experiment with new technologies and solutions. Our team is highly collaborative and works in a cross-functional organizational landscape with the following: Example of responsibilities Build core infrastructure: Contribute to building a large-scale, highly performant self-service data platform using cutting-edge technologies Innovate and improve: Drive internal tooling and process development to continuously increase data quality and constantly improve the engineering experience. Excellence in data management: Continuously improve on building capabilities for effective data utilization across Storytel. Collaboration: Collaborate with other engineers, data analysts, data scientists, and decision-makers to understand needs and build self-service. About you To be a fit for our team, we believe that you: Have a few years of hands-on experience in delivering data products and know the value of accurate consistent data infrastructure. Have experience in delivering infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Github (Github actions), and maintaining data orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, Airbyte. Have experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and data warehousing (preferably BigQuery). Have a good understanding of data access, storage, and optimization. Are able to break down and explain complicated technical solutions independent of stakeholders. Thrive in an environment focusing on innovation and collaboration and continuously work on personal development. Bonus qualifications: Experience with streaming data ingestion. Expertise in developing CI/CD pipelines tailored for data infrastructure. Join a world of stories At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us. Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile – no cover letter needed. Answer a few questions, and you’re all set.

headline: Analytics Engineer
description_text: Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others. As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place. Ready for your next chapter? We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team in Stockholm. About the Team We are proud of our ability to combine technical expertise with sound business sense. This translates to solutions that are not only effective in addressing current challenges but also sustainable long term. Our team is composed of Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers, fostering a collaborative environment that enables us to manage data end to end – from optimizing data pipelines to developing user-friendly models for analysis. Our technology stack includes BigQuery (SQL), Looker, dbt™, and Google Cloud Platform, with opportunities to evaluate and introduce new technologies as we scale. About the Role As an Analytics Engineer, you'll work with developing data capabilities that power decisions across our global organization. You'll have significant technical and organizational impact, driving both immediate solutions and long-term strategic initiatives. Examples of responsibilities: Develop data transformation steps and build a strong data modeling foundation for enabling self-service analytics across the company. Build and maintain trusting, working relationships with business partners across domains and discover high-impact opportunities to enable self-service analytics in our semantic layer. Strategically plan and deliver meaningful projects to increase data literacy at Storytel. Lead the resolution of critical data issues, establishing monitoring systems and best practices to prevent future problems and improve data reliability. Collaborate with data practitioners to understand their needs and requirements, breaking down complicated technical concepts to fit the audience. Drive adoption of technical best practices across the data team, mentoring others and bringing in industry innovations that improve how we work. We believe that you have Experience with creating and maintaining semantic layers. Experience in working with data (BI/Analytics/Data Engineering) specializing within Analytics Engineering. Deep expertise in SQL and data modeling and extensive experience with modern data stack technologies (e.g., dbt™, Looker, BigQuery, or equivalent tools). The ability to consistently deliver performant, accurate, and scalable solutions. Experience mentoring junior engineers and driving team-wide technical improvements. Proven ability to lead complex data projects, solve problems independently, and proactively improve products. Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to various audiences. The ability to thrive in a feedback culture and constantly strive to improve your own skills and knowledge. Bonus if you experience Working with Python. With data governance and access management. With different data modeling schemas. Working with international teams and global data operations. Join a world of stories At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us. Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile – no cover letter needed. Answer a few questions, and you’re all set. Does this sound like you? If you feel like Storytel is a place where you could thrive, please submit your application in English and we will contact you as soon as possible.

Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående. Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa . Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. headline: Business consultant within e-health
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. Are you ready to be part of something innovative? Are you motivated by improving healthcare or creating harmony between people and digital tools? Cambio is looking for Business Consultants within several clinical areas, including Lab, Order & Results, Emergency Care, Care Administration, Maternity/Obstetrics, and Surgery Process/Theatre Management . In this role, you will play a crucial part in our ongoing efforts to support our customers in the best possible way. One of your key responsibilities will be to communicate the value of our solutions to end users in healthcare. You will partly work on-site with customers, sometimes together with the customer’s system management team and sometimes directly with end users in the organization. The role also involves remote work, meaning you need to be comfortable managing customer interactions and other responsibilities through digital tools. As Business Consultant, you will contribute daily to developing our customers’ competence and understanding of our solutions, as well as leading training sessions and workshops. You will be involved in customer integrations, configuration, and implementation of our systems, and work with business analysis, process improvement, and quality assurance. About you As a person, you are communicative, pragmatic, humble, and driven. Self-leadership is a key factor for thriving and succeeding in this role. We believe you have the ability to translate our customers’ needs into opportunities within Cambio’s products and services. At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values. Requirements Extensive experience with COSMIC or similar EHR system, gained through implementation projects, application management, configuration, training, and support activities, or as an end user within one or more of the following product areas: -Emergency care -Care administration -Maternity/Obstetrics -Surgery process/ Theatre Management -Lab, Order & Results Strong communication skills and experience leading presentations, training sessions, or workshops. Knowledge of integration flows and how data moves between different systems within healthcare organizations. The ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks and deliveries. The ability to understand and describe business processes from both a user and operational perspective. Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish and English. It's a bonus if you Have experience in business analysis, process mapping, or improvement initiatives within healthcare. Understanding of national guidelines, regulations, or standards within the healthcare sector. Place of employment : Linköping or Stockholm Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: Willingness and ability to travel as required for the role The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. During the process we will conduct tests from our partner Alva Labs We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link. Due to the summer holiday period, feedback regarding the recruitment process may take a little longer than usual. We expect to get back to you no later than week 34. Thank you for your patience and understanding. CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible - explore our employee benefits Learn more about our recruitment process here Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

headline: MuleSoft Integration Developer
description_text: About the position We are currently seeking an Integration Developer with strong expertise in MuleSoft Anypoint. Ideally, you also bring experience in platform and infrastructure management within AWS to support our growing Integration Solutions team. If you're passionate about building scalable integration systems, automating infrastructure, and working in a collaborative, open-minded team, this could be your next exciting challenge. In this role, your main responsibility will be integration development within MuleSoft Anypoint platform. You will be a key member of the development team, as well as collaborate closely with the infrastructure team to manage the platform infrastructure, ensuring seamless system integration and robust infrastructure management. Why this role matters The Integration Solutions team is playing a key role in building a future-ready integration landscape. We have established a new Integration Competency Center (ICC) where you’ll be part of shaping the tools, processes, and infrastructure that support essential business operations across HR, Finance, Payroll, and more. What you will do Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and secure integration solutions using MuleSoft. Monitor and maintain platform performance with proactive incident and environment management. Collaborate with both IT and business stakeholders to translate needs into practical, scalable solutions. Work closely with Solution Architects and Integration Architects to continuously evolve our integration platform. Actively contribute to a transparent and agile team environment. Who you are We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and values honest collaboration. You might be a great match if you: Are passionate about technology and creating well-functioning, scalable integration solutions. Drive integrations from concept to production with a focus on automation, scalability, and continuous improvement. A strong communicator who can explain complex technical concepts in simple terms. Are pragmatic, proactive, and always looking for opportunities to improve tools and processes. Enjoy working closely with others and helping build a collaborative team culture. Embrace feedback and continuous learning as part of your daily work. What you bring We're looking for a strong mix of technical skills and collaborative mindset. Ideally, you have: Hands-on experience designing and implementing integration solutions using tools like MuleSoft, APIs, and event-driven messaging. Familiarity with CI/CD tools (like GitHub Actions) and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) is helpful, especially when collaborating with the infra team, but not essential. Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for creating maintainable, high-quality solutions. The ability to work independently while contributing actively to an agile, team-driven environment. Type of employment: Full-time, Permanent Location: Stockholm / Oslo (hybrid), Krakow (remote) Due to the vacation period, we will begin reviewing applications in August. Applications will be evaluated on an ongoing basis from that time, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet, and Podme. Every day we inform, engage, and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway, and Finland. Schibsted is covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Since 1839, trust has been our foundation. Our journalism empowers people, builds communities, and strengthens democracy – and innovation ensures we continue to protect that mission. Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

headline: IT Security Engineer
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position We are looking for a skilled and proactive Security Engineer to join our growing Security Operations team. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of strengthening our security capabilities and shaping how security is integrated across the organization. In this role, you will work hands-on with modern security platforms to identify, detect, and respond to threats, while continuously improving our overall security posture. The scope of the role is broad, focusing on security across the entire organization, both in terms of our internal environment and in how we support and secure our solutions for customers. You will act as both an operational expert and a trusted advisor, collaborating closely with IT Operations and Internal IT and other internal stakeholders. This is a role for someone who enjoys combining operational work with driving improvements, setting direction, and collaborating across the organization. Over time, there are great opportunities to grow and specialize within specific security domains as the team continues to expand. We offer: The opportunity to join a security area in an expansive phase, where you will work with modern technologies such as container platforms and be involved in both technical and architectural discussions. A welcoming and inclusive organization with a warm culture, where you will work with driven and dedicated colleagues who truly care about our customers and the positive impact we create for society. A role where you can influence how security capabilities are designed and implemented, while driving improvements and helping shape how we work with security going forward. A role where you can grow your skills and take on increasing responsibility within the security domain. About you You are a proactive and structured person who takes ownership of your work and enjoys driving things forward. At the same time, you are curious and eager to learn, especially within new technologies and evolving areas of security. You have strong collaboration skills and feel comfortable working closely with different teams and stakeholders, communicating in a clear and pragmatic way. You can balance a broader perspective with attention to detail, and you enjoy combining hands-on work with contributing to improvements over time. You’re motivated by growing in your role, taking on more responsibility, and being part of a team where you can make a real impact. Requirements At least 3 years of experience within Security Operations or a similar security-focused operational role. Hands-on experience with enterprise security platforms in both on-premises and cloud/container environments. Experience with incident response, vulnerability management and compliance. Proficiency in security tools and technologies, such as vulnerability scanning and e-mail security solutions. Understanding of network security, identity and access management and threat modeling. Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English It's a bonus if you have Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CEH, CISSP, or equivalent security certifications) are a plus. Experience with Zero Trust architecture and conditional access policies. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, CIS, MITRE ATT&CK framework). Experience with Security Log Management platforms. Additional information: Place of employment : Linköping or Stockholm Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. Due to the summer holiday period, feedback regarding the recruitment process may take a little longer than usual. We expect to get back to you no later than week 34. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We look forward to receiving your application!

headline: Spontanansökan: Jobba med oss på Omni
description_text: Vill du vara en del av Sveriges bästa redaktion? Omni har flera gånger prisats som Sveriges bästa nyhetstjänst och har både förändrat hur människor läser nyheter och moderniserat den redaktionella processen. Redaktörerna som jobbar hos oss är Sveriges bästa – och vi söker ständigt nya stjärnor! Omni är en liten och snabbrörlig redaktion som inte räds att pröva nya saker. Redaktörsrollen är lika rolig som utmanande och innebär i praktiken att du är nyhetschef, redaktör och reporter i ett. Du fattar blixtsnabba beslut under ett högt nyhetstempo och är en del av ett prestigelöst och väldigt engagerat team. Redaktör, Omni Vi tror att du: • är en av Sveriges bästa nyhetsreportrar eller nyhetsredaktörer, gärna med erfarenhet som arbetsledare. • har stor kunskap om och intresse för samhälls-, politik- och utrikesfrågor. • gillar högt tempo och tar stort eget ansvar. • gärna har erfarenhet av digitala utvecklingsprojekt på redaktioner. Det här kan vi erbjuda dig • ett 30-tal mycket engagerade och kompetenta kollegor med bakgrund på några av landets största redaktioner. • en stimulerande och prestigelös arbetsmiljö där allas insatser, kunskaper och idéer värderas högt. • möjligheten att utveckla Omnis bevakning och produkter inom de områden som intresserar dig mest. Låter detta som något för dig? Vi söker ständigt nya medarbetare till både längre vikariat och tillsvidaretjänster. Skicka in en ansökan och berätta varför just du skulle passa hos oss!

headline: DataOps Engineer
description_text: About the job Are you looking for a role where your engineering skills create real business value? As a DataOps Engineer in NOBA Bank Group, you’ll be instrumental in ensuring that raw data is efficiently transformed into structured, high-quality assets. You’ll play a key role in modernizing and maintaining our data infrastructure, implementing new technologies, and enabling the organization to innovate and grow through reliable, accessible, and well-managed data operations. About The Role The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision making across the business. This role is for Data Management & New Initiatives team under Data & Analytics Engineering department. In this role, you’ll design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines, partner with teams across the bank, and ensure that business critical data needs are met. You will take responsibility for ensuring continuous operations of our data warehouse across all domains, making sure daily processes run smoothly and data is readily accessible for all users. You’ll also monitor data infrastructure performance, proactively troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with other engineers to develop our security and business continuity best-practices. This is a great opportunity to enjoy a high degree of self-responsibility and expand your expertise into areas of your interest. You’ll collaborate broadly and see the tangible results of your work. We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team building, and enjoying fikas and after work gatherings together! Main Tasks Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using Databricks and dbt. Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for data workflows. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and DevOps teams to ensure robust, scalable, and reliable data operations. Monitor data infrastructure performance and proactively perform troubleshooting to ensure high availability and reliability. Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the data lifecycle. Monitor data infrastructure performance and proactively perform troubleshooting to ensure high availability and reliability. Enhance data usage and accessibility by applying modern data engineering practices Document processes and contribute to best practices. We Are Looking For You Who Enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering and operations, ensuring that data infrastructure is robust, efficient, and reliable. You are passionate about automating processes, monitoring systems, and proactively resolving issues to keep data flowing smoothly across the organization. You are proactive and detail-oriented, with a genuine curiosity for new technologies and best practices in Data. You thrive in collaborative environments, approach challenges with a “can-do” mindset, and enjoy transforming complex operational problems into practical, scalable solutions. You value a high degree of self-responsibility and are motivated to expand your expertise in areas that interest you, contributing to both the stability and innovation of our data platform. For This Role, You’ll Need Experience working in DataOps/ AI Ops, Data Engineering, or similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and operations. Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian. An academic degree in a relevant field such as data engineering, computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. Strong proficiency in ETL processes and data logic, with a solid understanding of how data is sourced, transformed, and delivered to end users. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure's data stack Practical experience working with both Databricks and dbt in a production environment. Ability to manage and automate data infrastructure resources (e.g., clusters, SQL Warehouses, permissions). Solid understanding of DevOps practices, including experience with version control systems and CI/CD tools. It's Positive If You Have Previous experience in data-focused roles within the financial sector. Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code Our offer to you Freedom with responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style and a high degree of self-responsibility. Career development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role, and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest. Feedback culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication. Coaching leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey. A caring company culture: We genuinely care about each other! You’ll also have the chance to work with cutting-edge data technologies and be part of shaping the future of NOBA’s data landscape. In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted , we collaborate and we take the lead . Practical information: Start: As soon as possible Location: Oslo/Stockholm Form of employment: Permanent position with probation period Extent: Full-time Working hours: Regular office hours Have you heard of NOBAVERSE? In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly ! ✨ Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page. Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ . We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health. Read more about how we handle your personal data here . If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter. We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

headline: Senior Network Administrator
description_text: In the role as a Senior Network Administrator you will join a team at the very core of Resurs, responsible for keeping all critical platforms running smoothly, from datacenter and networks to cloud and core banking systems, enabling the entire engineering organization to deliver seamlessly. We are currently in an exciting journey of change with many projects and activities where you have the opportunity to influence and develop both ways of working and technical solutions . The role includes contact with key suppliers within networks to ensure that existing agreements and solutions are fulfilled. The role also includes contact with other suppliers in order to monitor the outside world and maintain competence within the domain. Get an idea of the role In the role of Senior Network Administrator, you will amongst other tasks: Take care of daily operation of troubleshooting and case management Plan, implement and document network changes Implement and improve new and existing solutions Participate in the development and operation of our network About you To succeed in this role, we believe that you have at least 5 years of related work experience including experience with Palo Alto. You have good knowledge of various protocols, IP planning, and rule-based access. You also have experience with, or a strong interest in, network automation using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation, as well as cloud environments such as AWS. Experience of the following is an advantage for the position but not a requirement: Layer 3 routing protocols and technologies- BGP, OSPF, EIGRP MPLS and segment routing infrastructure Firewall technologies from Palo Alto Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, IOS-XR Routing & Switching Cisco ISE with 802.1x and MAB Cisco Catalyst Center IPAM, DNS, DHCP - AWS Akamai On a personal level You are driven by a desire to learn and adopt to new technologies in the segment. We believe you bring a strong sense of curiosity and initiative, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of your work from day one. As a person, you are responsible, analytical, independent, driven and structured. We also trust that you are a prestigious team player who is communicative, challenges problems and sees opportunities. Resurs in brief At Resurs, we make everyday finances easier through innovative and customer-focused solutions. With customers across the Nordics and more than 800 colleagues, we are committed to creating long-term value for individuals, businesses, and society. Recognized as a career company for the past six years, we put strong emphasis on both personal and professional growth. We want to make a difference by striving to be our best, acting with kindness, and building trust through clarity and collaboration. Our heart beats strong and it shows in everything we do. Although we are based in the Nordics, our team is enriched by the breadth of perspectives brought by colleagues from different countries. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users. Apply today! Don’t wait to send in your application. Selection and interviews take place on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date. We look forward to hearing from you! #LI-LN1
