headline: Cloud Engineer
description_text: We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer who enjoys working in the space where developers and infrastructure meet. Here, you’ll spend your time automating the mundane, architecting the complex, and scaling the future of our Azure AI and OpenAI offerings. This role is for you if you find more joy in writing a PowerShell script to solve a recurring app error than in managing a cluster’s networking. This is a code-centric role where infrastructure is treated as a software product. Everything you build is versioned, reviewed, tested, and continuously improved. Our goal is to reduce repetitive work and create the “Golden Paths” that let developers and AI teams deploy quickly, securely, and reliably. About the role: As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll help build and grow our Azure-based platform. You’ll own the design, automation, and delivery of modular cloud infrastructure, ensuring it’s resilient, scalable, and easy for teams to use. Your work will reduce friction, remove unnecessary steps, and make it simple for developers and data teams to focus on building features instead of worrying about infrastructure. What you’ll do: Build the "Golden Path" Pipelines: You won't just "run" pipelines; you will architect them. You’ll design and maintain CI/CD templates (YAML-based) that standardize how our applications are built, tested, and deployed. Your goal is to make the path from code-complete to production-ready as invisible and frictionless as possible for our developers. Automated Application Remediation: We don't believe in manual maintenance. You will use PowerShell and Azure DevOps to build automated pipelines for things like patching the container OS, reporting on deviations and self healing infrastructure Infrastructure as Versioned Code: You’ll design and implement modular Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), following the Azure Well-Architected Framework for reliability, performance, and cost. We are looking for you who have: Expert-level PowerShell skills : We operate in an environment where automation is built on PowerShell first. (Bash & Python are secondary) Proven experience with Azure Bicep: You should be comfortable treating infrastructure as a software product, versioning, testing and modularizing Bicep code. Developer-centric approach: You don't need to be a fullstack developer, but you need to understand application logic enough to automate patching, troubleshoot database connections, and optimize application performance within the cloud. Fluency in English (written and spoken). You’ll be comfortable owning tasks end to end and making technical decisions independently within the areas listed above. Ideally, you have some years of hands-on experience with Azure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, but we care more about what you can do and that you enjoy the field, rather than the exact number of years. It's positive if you have: Active Azure certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), AZ-204 (Developer Associate) Experience from regulated or security-conscious environments is a plus In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead. headline: Senior Data Engineer
description_text: Join our data transformation journey and help shape the future of Nordic banking As we continue our exciting cloud transformation journey, we're looking for a Senior Data Engineer who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling our modern data platform from the ground up. You'll be essential in creating the data foundation that powers decision-making across our business and drives innovation in Nordic financial services. We offer a hybrid remote work solution within Sweden, with occasional visits to our HQ in Helsingborg. Get an idea of the role As a Senior Data Engineer at Resurs, you'll be at the forefront of our cloud transformation, working with cutting-edge AWS technologies to build scalable, secure, and efficient data solutions. You'll collaborate closely with data scientists, analysts, product teams, and business stakeholders to transform how we leverage data to create value for our customers and drive business growth. Your key responsibilities will include: Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines and architectures using modern AWS services and cloud-native technologies Build and implement scalable unified data platform solutions that support advanced analytics and data-driven decision making Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all data flows, adhering to banking regulations and compliance requirements Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust, scalable data products Drive best practices for DataOps, monitoring, and automated data pipeline orchestration Mentor junior team members and contribute to the evolution of our data engineering standards and practices Lead technical decision-making for data architecture and tooling within assigned projects On a personal level You're likely a curious and collaborative professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys solving complex technical challenges. You have a passion for turning data into actionable insights and take pride in building systems that scale. We believe you also bring: Essential experience: A proven track record of delivering scalable data solutions in cloud environments Strong expertise with AWS data services (ECS, S3, Athena, and related services) Advanced SQL skills and experience with modern data warehouse architectures, optimization techniques, and transformation tools like dbt Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CDK, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines Strong Python skills for data processing and pipeline development Experience with data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, or similar) Strong understanding of data governance, security, and compliance in regulated industries Nice to have: Experience in banking, fintech, or other regulated financial industries Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and serverless architectures Background in agile development methodologies and DataOps practices Personal qualities: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with attention to detail Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential issues Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging data technologies Resurs in brief At Resurs, we make everyday finances easier through innovative and customer-focused solutions. With customers across the Nordics and a team of around 800 colleagues, we are committed to delivering long-term value for individuals, businesses, and society. Being named a career company for the past six years, we have a strong focus on emphasizing both personal and professional growth. With an inclusive and diverse culture, we create a workplace where employees are valued, supported, and encouraged to reach their full potential. Although we are based in the Nordics, our team is enriched by the breadth of perspectives brought by colleagues from different countries. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users. Apply today! Don’t wait to send in your application. headline: Customer Advisor på deltid till Privatlån (Existing Customer)
description_text: Nu söker vi en Customer Advisor på deltid till vårt Existing-team på Privatlåneavdelningen. På Privatlån omges du av kompetenta kollegor, en fin gemenskap och ett stöttande ledarskap ✨ Om rollen: Som Customer Advisor arbetar du alltid med telefonen i högsta hugg för att hantera inkommande och utgående samtal med våra befintliga kunder. 📞Du kan hjälpa våra kunder med fakturainformation, göra låneansökningar, skaffa tilläggslån, se status på låneansökningar, hantera försäkringar i dialog med kund och mycket mer. I rollen kommer du även att arbeta med winback-samtal, där ditt fokus är att återetablera relationen med kunder som är på väg att avsluta sitt lån. Du kommer att lyssna in kundernas behov, identifiera orsaker till avslut och erbjuda lösningar som skapar värde och bygger långsiktig lojalitet. Kopplat till samtalen tillkommer en del administration ✉️ och chattkontakt men rollen i sig är telefonbaserad och därför söker vi dig som trivs med att prata med kunder och som ser varje samtal som en möjlighet att hjälpa! För att trivas i rollen som Customer Advisor ser vi att du behöver ha ett intresse för försäljning och tycka om att arbeta mot uppsatta mål. 🏆 Bra att veta: När du påbörjar denna tjänst kommer du att gå en utbildning på 4 veckor som är förlagd på heltid på kontoret. Under dessa veckor ser vi gärna att du deltar på utbildningen i så hög utsträckning som möjligt, för att du ska få så bra förutsättningar och en så bra upplärning som möjligt. Under denna period ser vi därför gärna att du förlägger studier till kvällar och helger, men självklart går det bra att du deltar på obligatoriska moment i skolan. Vi söker dig som: Har arbetat inom service med fördel från roller inom butik, restaurang, resebolag, telefon, försäljning eller liknande - resten lär vi dig! Har intresse för att hjälpa kunder i en serviceroll med försäljningsmål Kan arbeta deltid i minst 1 år och har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning om minst 50% under denna tid. Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska, norska är meriterande Är bekväm med att dagligen tala med norska kunder För att trivas och prestera väl i rollen tror vi att du behöver vara: Serviceinriktad & kommunikativ: Du har en förmåga att lyssna och förstå människors olika behov, samtidigt som du i kontakt med andra människor kan uttrycka dig på ett pedagogiskt sätt. 🌱 Resultatorienterad: Du drivs av att uppnå konkreta resultat och mål, exempelvis försäljningsmål. 🏆 Lösningsorienterad: Du har en förmåga att kunna identifera lösningar på olika problem. 🙏🏽 Flexibel: Du kan anpassa dig till olika situationer som uppstår i arbetet och kan prioritera uppgifter utifrån verksamhetens behov. 🤸‍♀️ Utöver detta är det viktigt för oss att du känner igen dig i våra värderingar: vi är helhjärtade, vi samarbetar och vi tar ledningen.
